The '''Axxilan antipirate fleet''' was a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|peacekeeping]] patrol [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] situated in the [[Ciutric Hegemony]]. Under the leadership of [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]], it helped the Hegemony become the safest regions of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].
